description: Silk is possibly the easiest way to start enjoying self-care every day. Do you know why?
It’s not just about having a luxurious and durable (healthy for you, healthy for the planet) towels/bath, scarf or bedding silk…

♥ The silk used at Mimi is Mulberry silk. Mulberry silk is the best in the industry, creating the most natural and best quality fabric. Mulberry silk is known for its rich smoothness, strength, durability, and beautiful, even appearance.

♥ This beautiful silk towel is hand-woven by the women from the Thai ethnic group in a mountainous region in Nghe An province, a land of “Ruou Can” (wine drunk out of a jar through bamboo pipes) of Vietnam. This premium towels are made by silk artisans according to the traditional production method and are infused with healthy proteins that protect users' skin from the elements.

♥ The product has the original natural color of the silk yarn and/or naturally dyed using colors from flowers and plants that are inherent in Thai food and herbal medicines such as tea leaf, Cham, Canh Kien, coffee, turmeric, medicinal herbs, etc…

♥ The towels are great for all skin types with natural properties. In addition, the premium towels are designed for everyday use with odorless properties for a fresh scent. The super absorbent silk makes them perfect to incorporate into your daily beauty routine to help reduce the signs of aging.

♥ Silk is possibly the easiest way to start enjoying self-care every day. Simply treating yourself to a new silk bath towel could be the first step to a whole new you, a new level of luxuriousness to life, enhancing our mood, sleep, comfort, and peace.
Our favorite way to invest in ourselves is, of course, with silk!
